title: tenant-cmk-assertion-plus-audit-dedupe
author: Priya Malhotra
description:
Motivation: Tighten tenant-bound CMK usage assertions in the service-side KMS allocator and eliminate duplicate audit entries emitted by the log-forwarder when requests are retried. This change reduces the risk of cross-tenant key misuse and significantly lowers audit noise that has been confusing SREs and compliance reviewers.

What this PR does (high level):
- Enforces a tenant-scoped check in the runtime KMS allocator: requests that carry a tenant claim must be bound to the tenant's CMK alias or be explicitly allowed via a tenant-level exception list.
- Adds a deterministic CMK resolution path that prefers explicit tenant bindings, then tenant-affine regional fallbacks; misbindings now return a 403 with audit tag metadata.
- Implements an idempotent audit deduplication layer in the audit-forwarder: audit envelopes carry a new stable event_id derived from request UUID, tenant_id, and authorization version to prevent duplicate entries from retries.
- Adds e2e integration tests that simulate retries, regional failovers, and mixed-tenant traffic to validate both enforcement and dedup semantics.

Design notes:
- KMS assertion lives in runtime/kms/allocator and is gated behind feature flag feature.tenant_cmk_assertion (off by default for rollout). When enabled, allocator performs two checks: (1) tenant CMK alias matches request claim; (2) the CMK's region matches request's region pin when present.
- Audit dedupe is implemented as an idempotent envelope filter in observability/audit-forwarder. New audit_envelope.event_id is HMAC-SHA256(key=service-audit-key, data=tenant_id||request_uuid||auth_version). Envelopes with the same event_id within a 5m sliding window are collapsed. A metrics counter audit.dedupe.filtered is exposed.
- To preserve backwards compatibility we add a compatibility header X-Redwood-Audit-Event-V1 and a migration flag audit.forwarder.v2 (controlled via config).

Checklist:
- [x] Runtime allocator check with unit tests
- [x] Audit-forwarder dedupe with integration tests
- [x] Feature flag gating and rollout plan in README
- [x] Documentation updates (security playbook + console notes)
- [x] Linear/Jira links added to PR

Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main behind feature flag off.
2) Deploy audit-forwarder with dedupe enabled in staging only; monitor audit.dedupe.filtered and audit.latency.
3) Enable runtime assertion in canary region for small subset of tenants with manual opt-in.
4) Gradually increase canary %, then globally enable after two maintenance windows with no elevated alerts.

Risk considerations:
- Misconfigured tenant aliases will lead to 403s; we added clear error codes and a console listing to help operators map aliases to tenants.
- Dedupe window trades off eventual de-duplication vs. potential suppression of legitimate replays; window default 5m is conservative and configurable.

Related: ENG-6234, PM-190, SUP-8121.

review_conversation:
Owen Park: Can you explain how the HMAC key is rotated without invalidating the event_id window?
Priya Malhotra: Good question — the forwarder keeps a small grace list of previous keys (currently prev-1) and will accept event_ids computed with either the current or the preceding key for the duration of the window. Rotation steps are documented in docs/ops/rollout-playbooks.
Liu Zhang: There are a couple of places where we read tenant claims from headers; please ensure we prefer authenticated token claims not headers.
Priya Malhotra: Fixed in allocator.go — token claims are now canonical source, headers used only as fallback during ingress-layer compatibility. Updated unit tests to cover both flows.
Rana Singh: Needs an audit log schema bump? We should version envelopes so older consumers keep parsing.
Priya Malhotra: Added X-Redwood-Audit-Event-V1 header and migration flag as discussed.
Owen Park: CI flake on integration (timeout) — rerunning.

release_notes: Enforce tenant-scoped CMK bindings in KMS allocator (feature-flagged). Add idempotent audit deduplication in audit-forwarder with metrics audit.dedupe.filtered. Admins should review tenant CMK mappings in Console before enabling. See docs/security/tenant-cmk-assertion.md for details.
notes_for_ops: If enabling feature.tenant_cmk_assertion, pre-populate tenant CMK alias mapping using console or the /admin/tenant-keys API. Monitor audit.dedupe.filtered and audit.forwarder.latency for first 24h. Key rotation must include prev-1 grace key as documented.
